message: Mere paas sirf kettlebell hai, dumbbell row kaise karun?

raw.text: Dumbbell ki jagah kettlebell se bhi yahi karo: 2 sets, 8-12 reps, beech mein 75 sec rest, aur har set ke end mein lagbhag 3 reps baaki rehne chahiye. message: How many reps should I leave in the tank on the bird dog?

raw.text: Leave 3 reps in the tank on the bird dog, across 2 sets of 8 to 12 reps with 75 seconds of rest between sets. That means you stop each set when you feel you could still do about 3 more good, controlled reps. If your form starts to slip before then, end the set there.

message: Is the band good morning okay if my hamstrings feel tight?

raw.text: Feeling tight is not the same as feeling pain. If it's only tightness, you can keep the band good morning light: 2 sets of 10 to 15 reps, stopping with 3 reps left in reserve and a short range you can control. If you feel pain, stop the movement and don't push through it. If you're not sure which one it is, tell me this: does the tightness turn into pain or feel sharp when you bend forward?
